ops.oldText: 7.6 Customer shall pay Vendor USD 25,000 per day as agreed liquidated damages for any delay in providing a dependency.
ops.newText: 7.6 If Customer delays in providing a dependency, Vendor's sole remedy is a day-for-day extension of the affected schedule or milestone dates, and Customer shall not be liable for liquidated damages or any other penalty for that delay.

input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept liquidated damages payable by us, so we have replaced the USD 25,000 per day charge with day-for-day schedule relief for Vendor, which addresses the delay without an uncapped penalty. Our playbook position is no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer.
input.summary: Replace Customer-payable liquidated damages for dependency delay with day-for-day schedule relief.
